description: A 3D SKETCH POINT SNAPPED TO A MODEL VERTEX (SKETCH-3D, RESEARCH §28): a 40 x 20 x 10 box (extrude of a rectangle on XY), a 3D sketch whose point 'corner' is attached to the top end (signature end b) of the box's vertical edge at x=40, y=20, and a free point typed at z=55; the line between them is Along Z with a driving Length of 50, so the free end slides 5 mm up to (40, 20, 60). A solid Pipe of OD 10 on that line is a NEW body (merge false), so the part is the box plus a cylinder standing on its corner. Locks the vertex snap's resolution (it reports its tier: exact) and Pipe on a 3D line.
derivation: Solved points by hand: corner = (40, 20, 10), the edge's upper end; top = corner + 50 z = (40, 20, 60) (Along Z holds x and y; the length slides the free end along the line). DOF 0.
Area = box 2 (800 + 400 + 200) = 2800 + cylinder side pi 10 * 50 + two caps 2 * 25 pi = 4527.875959474386 (separate bodies share no face).
Bounding box: the box from the origin; the cylinder spans x 35..45, y 15..25, z 10..60: (0, 0, 0) .. (45, 25, 60).
Topology: box 6 faces / 12 edges, cylinder 3 faces / 3 edges (side, two caps, seam), 2 shells. Mesh recorded from the harness.
tolerance_rationale: A planar box and an analytic cylinder: measured 2026-10-22 against the hand numbers, volume 3e-12 mm^3, area 2e-12 mm^2, centroid below 1e-12 mm. 1e-6 is the analytic primitives' bound; never loosen it to go green.
